cite.note: Também há registros ativos de "decanoato de haloperidol".

dose_adult.note: Faixa inicial da bula: sintomas moderados 0,5 a 2 mg, e graves 3 a 5 mg, 2 ou 3 vezes ao dia (1 a 15 mg/dia, calculado). Idosos ou debilitados: 0,5 a 2 mg 2 ou 3 vezes ao dia. A bula não tem indicação para transtorno bipolar.

cite.locator: seção DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION (Oral Administration, Initial Dosage Range, Adults)
cite.quote: Moderate Symptomatology - 0.5 mg to 2 mg b.i.d. or t.i.d. Severe Symptomatology - 3 mg to 5 mg b.i.d. or t.i.d.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "Daily dosages up to 100 mg may be necessary in some cases to achieve an optimal response."

cite.locator: Boxed warning: Increased mortality in elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis
cite.quote: Elderly patients with dementia-related psychosis treated with antipsychotic drugs are at an increased risk of death.
Cases of sudden death, QT-prolongation, and Torsades de pointes have been reported in patients receiving haloperidol.
cite.note: Mesma seção: doses acima das recomendadas parecem associadas a maior risco; cautela especial com outros fatores que prolongam o QT, incluindo medicamentos que prolongam o QT.

cite.quote: A syndrome consisting of potentially irreversible, involuntary, dyskinetic movements may develop in patients treated with antipsychotic drugs.
cite.note: Seção ADVERSE REACTIONS: "EPS during the administration of haloperidol have been reported frequently, often during the first few days of treatment."

cite.quote: Haloperidol tablets may cause somnolence, postural hypotension, motor and sensory instability, which may lead to falls and, consequently, fractures or other injuries.

cite.locator: seção WARNINGS: Usage in Pregnancy (Nonteratogenic Effects)
cite.quote: Neonates exposed to antipsychotic drugs, during the third trimester of pregnancy are at risk for extrapyramidal and/or withdrawal symptoms following delivery.
cite.note: Mesma seção: relatos de malformações de membros com uso materno de haloperidol junto a outros fármacos no 1º trimestre, sem relação causal estabelecida.

cite.locator: seção WARNINGS: Usage in Pregnancy (Nonteratogenic Effects)
cite.quote: Infants should not be nursed during drug treatment.
As with other antipsychotic agents, it should be noted that haloperidol may be capable of potentiating CNS depressants such as anesthetics, opiates, and alcohol.
cite.note: Seção WARNINGS (General): "The use of alcohol with this drug should be avoided due to possible additive effects and hypotension."

cite.locator: seção PRECAUTIONS: Leukopenia, Neutropenia and Agranulocytosis
cite.quote: In clinical trial and post-marketing experience, events of leukopenia/neutropenia have been reported temporally related to antipsychotic agents, including haloperidol. Agranulocytosis (including fatal cases) has also been reported.
receiving anticonvulsant medications, with a history of seizures, or with EEG abnormalities, because haloperidol may lower the convulsive threshold
Antipsychotic drugs elevate prolactin levels; the elevation persists during chronic administration.
cite.note: Mesma seção: galactorreia, amenorreia, ginecomastia e impotência foram relatadas, mas a relevância clínica da prolactina elevada é desconhecida para a maioria dos pacientes.

cite.locator: seção ADVERSE REACTIONS: Withdrawal Emergent Neurological Signs
cite.quote: However, some patients on maintenance treatment experience transient dyskinetic signs after abrupt withdrawal.
cite.note: Mesma seção: "it seems reasonable to gradually withdraw use of haloperidol." Em tratamentos curtos, a bula diz que a retirada abrupta em geral não causa problemas.

cite.quote: EPS during the administration of haloperidol have been reported frequently, often during the first few days of treatment. EPS can be categorized generally as Parkinson-like symptoms, akathisia, or dystonia (including opisthotonos and oculogyric crisis).

common_effects.note: Bula de haloperidol oral (transtornos psicóticos e Tourette). Não há lista de reações mais comuns: é a única frase sobre frequência e trata só dos sintomas extrapiramidais.
